run_eval_pretrain: run the eval_pretrain script to evaluate a pretrained model on ImageNet validation set
run_train_network: run the train_network function to train a model on a dataset with cross entropy loss
run_adjust_learning_rate: run the adjust_learning_rate function to decay the learning rate every 30 epochs
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to generate an argparse parser with training and model parameters
run_main: run the main function to initialize distributed training, load data, and start supervised training
